# Qualia — Frontend Design System

> This document defines the visual language for Qualia. Every component and page must follow these patterns.
> Built on **Tailwind CSS v4** + **Shadcn/UI** — uses `@theme` for design tokens, `@custom-variant` for dark mode, and Shadcn CSS variables for component theming.
>
> **References:**
> - Tailwind CSS v4 Theme: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/theme
> - Tailwind CSS v4 Dark Mode: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/dark-mode
> - Shadcn/UI: https://ui.shadcn.com

---

## 1. Color Palette

Qualia is a dark-mode-first app. The default state is dark. We use Tailwind's built-in `zinc` scale for neutral surfaces and `sky` as the primary accent color, plus `red` for destructive actions.

### Semantic Color Map

Use these exact Tailwind classes — never hardcode hex values.

| Role | Class | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| **Page background** | `bg-zinc-950` | `<body>`, root layout |
| **Surface / Card** | `bg-zinc-900` | Cards, containers, sections |
| **Elevated surface** | `bg-zinc-800` | Modals, dropdowns, raised panels |
| **Hover surface** | `bg-zinc-700` | Hover state on cards/rows |
| **Border** | `border-zinc-700` | Default border color, dividers |
| **Border subtle** | `border-zinc-800` | Subtle separation lines |
| **Text primary** | `text-white` | Headings, primary content |
| **Text secondary** | `text-zinc-300` | Body text, descriptions |
| **Text muted** | `text-zinc-500` | Placeholders, timestamps, hints |
| **Primary accent** | `text-sky-400` / `bg-sky-500` | Links, primary buttons, active states |
| **Primary hover** | `bg-sky-400` | Hover on primary buttons |
| **Primary active** | `bg-sky-600` | Active/pressed primary buttons |
| **Danger** | `text-red-400` / `bg-red-500` | Delete buttons, error messages |
| **Danger hover** | `bg-red-400` | Hover on destructive buttons |
| **Success** | `text-emerald-400` | Confirmation text, success states |
| **Focus ring** | `ring-sky-500/50` | Focus outlines on interactive elements |

### Tailwind v4 Theme Extension

In `globals.css`, extend the theme to create semantic aliases and map Shadcn CSS variables to the Qualia palette:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));

@theme {
  --color-surface: oklch(21% 0.006 285.885);           /* zinc-900 */
  --color-surface-elevated: oklch(27.4% 0.006 286.033); /* zinc-800 */
  --color-border: oklch(37% 0.013 285.805);             /* zinc-700 */
}

/* Shadcn CSS variables — mapped to Qualia palette */
:root {
  --background: oklch(8.5% 0.006 285.885);  /* zinc-950 */
  --foreground: oklch(98% 0 0);             /* white */
  --primary: oklch(62% 0.19 228);           /* sky-500 */
  --primary-foreground: oklch(98% 0 0);
  --muted: oklch(21% 0.006 285.885);
  --muted-foreground: oklch(65% 0.006 286);  /* zinc-400 */
  --border: oklch(37% 0.013 285.805);
  --ring: oklch(62% 0.19 228);
}
```

---

## 2. Typography

| Element | Classes |
|---|---|
| Page title (h1) | `text-2xl font-bold text-white` |
| Section title (h2) | `text-lg font-semibold text-white` |
| Card title (h3) | `text-base font-medium text-white` |
| Body text | `text-sm text-zinc-300` |
| Caption / hint | `text-xs text-zinc-500` |
| Label | `text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300` |

> **Rule:** All description, hint, helper, and caption text must use `text-zinc-500`. Never use `text-zinc-400` or `text-zinc-600` for descriptive text.

---

## 3. Layout & Spacing

- **Mobile-first.** Design for 375px width, then expand with `md:` prefixes.
- **Max content width:** `max-w-lg` (512px) on mobile, `max-w-4xl` (896px) on `md+`, centered with `mx-auto`.
- **Page padding:** `px-4 py-6` on mobile.
- **Section spacing:** `space-y-6` between major sections, `space-y-4` within sections.
- **Card padding:** `p-4` on mobile, `p-6` on larger screens.
- **All scrollable `<main>` elements:** `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto`.

---

## 4. Components

### 4.1 Shadcn vs Custom

Use **Shadcn/UI primitives** for: `Sheet`, `Dialog`, `Calendar`, `Button`, `Toggle`, `Popover`.
Use **raw Tailwind** for: custom layouts, stat cards, streak indicators, list rows, and anything not covered by Shadcn.

Do not hand-edit files in `src/components/ui/` — they are generated by the Shadcn CLI and will be overwritten.

### 4.2 Container / Card

```
rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 p-4
```

With elevation:
```
rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 p-4 shadow-lg shadow-black/20
```

### 4.3 Buttons

**Primary Button (custom — or use Shadcn `<Button>` with custom variant)**
```
h-12 rounded-xl bg-sky-500 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white
hover:bg-sky-400 active:bg-sky-600
disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors
focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-500/50
```

**Secondary Button (outline)**
```
h-11 rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300
hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-30 transition-colors
focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-500/50
```

**Danger Button**
```
rounded-lg bg-red-500 px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white
hover:bg-red-400 transition-colors
```

**Icon Button**
```
flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-400
hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white transition-colors
```

### 4.4 Text Inputs

Large, tap-friendly. Minimum height `h-12` (48px touch target).

```
h-12 w-full rounded-xl bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700 px-4 text-sm text-white
placeholder:text-zinc-500
focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500/50 focus:border-sky-500
disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed
```

**Textarea (savor moment input)**
```
min-h-[80px] w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white
placeholder:text-zinc-500 resize-none
focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500/50 focus:border-sky-500
```

### 4.5 Toggle (Connection Hit / Flow State)

Use Shadcn `<Toggle>` as the base. Checked state:
```
data-[state=on]:bg-sky-500/20 data-[state=on]:text-sky-400 data-[state=on]:border-sky-500/50
```
Unchecked:
```
bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700
```

### 4.6 Navigation Bar

Fixed bottom bar. Four tabs: **Today | Vault | Analytics | Profile**.

```
Bar:        fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-zinc-950/95 backdrop-blur-sm
Inner:      border-t border-zinc-800 max-w-4xl mx-auto
Tab:        flex flex-col items-center gap-1 py-2 px-4 text-xs text-zinc-500
Tab active: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 py-2 px-4 text-xs text-sky-400 font-medium
```

### 4.7 Streak / Stat Card

```
rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 p-4 flex flex-col gap-1
Value: text-2xl font-bold text-white tabular-nums
Label: text-xs text-zinc-500
```

### 4.8 Calendar Day Indicator

- **Logged day:** `bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-400` ring or dot
- **Today (not logged):** `ring-1 ring-zinc-600 text-white`
- **Empty past day:** `text-zinc-600`
- **Today (logged):** `bg-sky-500 text-white`

### 4.9 Badge / Tag

```
inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-sky-500/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-sky-400
```

Muted variant:
```
inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-zinc-800 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400
```

### 4.10 Divider

```
border-t border-zinc-800
```

---

## 5. Interaction States

| State | Pattern |
|---|---|
| **Hover** | Lighten surface one step (e.g. zinc-900 → zinc-800) |
| **Focus** | `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-sky-500/50` + `focus-visible:outline-none` |
| **Active / Pressed** | Darken accent one step (sky-500 → sky-600) |
| **Disabled** | `opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed` |
| **Loading** | `animate-pulse` on skeleton shapes, spinner with `animate-spin` |

---

## 6. Iconography

- Use [Heroicons](https://heroicons.com/) (outline style, 24px).
- Icon color inherits text color. Use `size-5` (20px) inline, `size-6` (24px) for nav, `size-4` (16px) for compact.

---

## 7. General Rules

1. **No inline styles.** Use Tailwind utility classes only.
2. **No custom CSS** unless defined in `globals.css` for theme tokens.
3. **Consistent rounding:** `rounded-lg` for interactive elements, `rounded-xl` for cards/containers.
4. **Touch targets:** Minimum 44×44px for all tappable elements (buttons, inputs, nav tabs).
5. **Transitions:** Use `transition-colors` on hover/focus elements. Keep duration default (150ms).
6. **Spacing rhythm:** Stick to the 4px grid — use `gap-1` through `gap-6`, avoid arbitrary values.
7. **Shadcn components** inherit their appearance from CSS variables. Keep CSS variable mappings in sync with the Tailwind palette defined above — they must not diverge.
